scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Demon Pungus?
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
你打完了50只天邪鬼吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
嗯，我觉得你还没打够50只...

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Remember, I need help hunting Demon Pungus so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
记住，我需要你帮忙打天邪鬼，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
